constraints: No recognizable classical or real architecture
No people, text, logos, dashboards, workflows, or generic AI imagery
White fields and light planes remain pure neutral white with no cream, ivory, beige, or yellow cast
Horizon Court is the rendering master for field, linework, texture, scale, and negative space
Exactly one tiny orange Signal sits on or immediately beside the distant horizon or vanishing point
No orange foreground object or decorative accent
Rounded expressions use broad structural arcs, protected apertures, or returning planes; never pills, bubbles, blobs, or soft-SaaS decoration
